headline: Use 2 of your 3 free transfers to clear the dead bench. Hold the wildcard.
summary: Wieffer (knee injury, 0% chance, no return date) and Dovin (loaned to Leyton Orient for the season) are both permanently dead. That is GBP 9.0m of a 15-man squad doing nothing, and you currently have no goalkeeper cover.
OUT Wieffer, IN Egan (HUL, GBP 4.0m): highest 8-gameweek projection of any defender at or below GBP 5.1m (31.7), driven by defensive-contribution points, and he frees GBP 1.0m.
OUT Dovin, IN Leno (FUL, GBP 4.5m): fixes the dead keeper slot, and Leno actually outprojects Tzolakis over the horizon (28.3 vs 26.8), so it is an upgrade rather than just cover.
Leaves GBP 0.9m banked and 1 free transfer in reserve for news before the 12 Sep deadline.
Do NOT play the second wildcard: the solver rates it at only +4.7 expected points over the no-chip plan, which is a poor use of your last first-half chip.
Do NOT sell Semenyo. The rank-utility objective wanted to because he is 28.9% owned in this league, but his 36.6 expected points over GW4-11 is the best in your squad after Haaland.
Captaincy is close for GW4 (Gakpo 4.86 vs Haaland 4.53) and does not need deciding until the deadline.
objective: expected points, with the solver's wildcard and Semenyo calls overridden
